column1: !!SBtab TableID='ConfigureSTM' TableType='Config' SBtabVersion='1.2' Method='structural-thermokinetic-modeling' TableName='Default options of Structural Thermokinetic Modeling (STM) (Matlab)'
% Default options of the Matlab implementation, assembled from stm_default_options.m (stm).
% Empty values: option is empty by default ([] in Matlab); vector-valued options are
% described in the column !Description. Flags: 1 (true) or 0 (false).
% STM options are stored in two Matlab structs, 'stm_options' and 'stm_constraints' (prefixes of the IDs).
% These are the STM-specific options; stm_default_options also contains the general flux and thermodynamic
% options and constraints of the Metabolic Network Toolbox (table ConfigureFluxConstraints; Matlab function
% flux_constraints_default_options), with prefixes 'stm_options' and 'stm_constraints' instead of 'options' and 'constraints'.
% For vectors and matrices (nr: number of reactions; nm: number of metabolites), the value given is used for all elements.
